| `count as u32` / `count as u64` lossy casts | `u32::try_from(count)` / `u64::try_from(count)` |
| `total / count` unchecked div | `total.checked_div(count_u64).ok_or(Invalid)?` |
| Wrong return type `Result<String, _>` | `Result<Summary, _>` matching test contract |
| Missing `render_summary` function | Added pure formatting function |
| Empty input not detected | `count == 0` check returns `Empty` |
